title: Mastery of Foresight
summary: Follow personal and raid warnings to survive the Trial of Foresight.
overview: Follow personal and raid warnings to survive the Trial of Foresight.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Move to the announced safe side when the room heats up.
Read your kyv warning carefully: it may require moving, standing still or ducking.
Remove the specified rings or main-hand weapon when the equipment warning appears.
Watch dragorn preparations and respond with distance or focused damage as the warning directs.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
